name: job_kill
description: Cancel a job by its `job_id`. Agent jobs (`job_...`) stop their live run; pending user jobs (`ujob_...`) are recalled so the human no longer needs to do them. Terminal jobs cannot be killed (job_kill reports the current status).

job_id.description: The job id (e.g. job_... for a background job, or ujob_... for a user job).

prompt: job_kill: cancel a background job (`job_...`) or a pending user job (`ujob_...`) by `job_id`. Completed or already-cancelled jobs cannot be killed.
